name: Mohd Najwadi Yusoff, Ts. Dr.
currentResearchCluster:
Enabling Technologies And Infrastructures Computing (ETIC)


SPECIALIZATION
Cybersecurity, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR), Cryptography and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), AI for Cybersecurity, Blockchain and Decentralized Security, Cybercrime and Privacy Engineering, Secure Protocols and Distributed Systems Security, Critical Information Infrastructure Protection (CII)



Qualifications

Bachelor of Technology (Hons.) in Information Technology, Universiti Teknologi PETRONAS
Master of Science, Computer Science, Universiti Sains Malaysia
Ph. D, Security in Computing, Universiti Putra Malaysia

RESEARCH INTEREST

Cyber Threat Intelligence and Adversarial OperationsFocus on Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), threat hunting, and Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) campaign analysis, including research on the dark web and cybercrime ecosystems.
Malware, Exploitation and DeceptionWork in malware analysis and reverse engineering, vulnerability research and exploit development, as well as deception technologies and honeypot systems.
AI for CybersecurityResearch on AI-driven threat detection, adversarial machine learning, and the security of AI systems, including the analysis of attacks against machine learning models and the development of robust and trustworthy AI for security applications.
Digital Forensics and Incident ResponseCovering host, network and memory forensics, malware and fileless attack investigations, and cloud or container forensics, along with incident investigation, forensic automation, and anti-forensics techniques.
Systems and Infrastructure SecurityIncluding cloud-native and container security, blockchain and cryptocurrency security, and protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CII).
Cryptography, Privacy and Secure SystemsFocusing on privacy engineering, secure protocols, and cryptography, including post-quantum cryptography (PQC).
